name: Receive From OpenShelf
description: Receive an item from the OpenShelf: the cabinet retrieves it by name (blocks until done), then the right arm reaches the plate anchor, grabs it, and carries it home.
author: zeon

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Item name to receive from the OpenShelf (case-insensitive)

nodes.label: Dispense From OpenShelf
nodes.description: Call the OpenShelf API to dispense the named object from the cabinet and present it at the plate anchor (embeds the snap); blocks until the cabinet physically finishes (~50s).

nodes.label: Reach OpenShelf
nodes.description: Right arm moves to the OpenShelf plate anchor where the item is presented.

nodes.label: Grab Item
nodes.description: Gradually close the right gripper on the item and attach it so it travels with the arm.

nodes.label: Back Out Of Box
nodes.description: Pull the arm (with the item) straight out of the IO box along +Y before homing, so it clears the shelf.

nodes.label: Carry Home
nodes.description: Return the right arm (holding the item) to its home rest pose.
